title: 第十九章所以燃烧吧我的小宇宙新书求推荐票求月票求收藏第二十章黄金枪Flashing Lancer新书求推荐票求月票
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第十九章所以……燃烧吧，我的小宇宙！
【新书，求推荐票，求月票，求收藏】
“啊呸*｀へ′*！”
“原来你竟然是这样的曹孟德！”
“你这无耻老贼，还在这里嘤嘤狂吠，我从来没有想到，世上竟真有你这般厚颜无耻之徒！”
在场几十位诸侯武将，听着曹老板将自己先进的人文主义知识侃侃而谈时，纷纷在内心深处暗自唾弃曹老板，那恬不知耻的个人作风！
但唾弃归唾弃。
却一点都不妨碍，大家不知不觉将自己的耳朵竖的高高。
大家默不作声间，是要将曹老板一生的人生经验都要学会，学熟，学通，一定要青出于蓝胜于蓝。
王璃同学撇了这些人一眼，心头分外不耻，懒得搭理这帮家伙：“我呸！
你们一个个究竟是怀着什么样的心思，真以为我看不出来？我王璃就是心善，不想当着面说穿而已。”
王璃一边不断暗自唾弃这帮，一边又在点头。
不得不说，曹老板现在虽然还没进化到他以后的那般“究极体”
，但有些道理那是一脉相承，王璃听得都是大开眼界。
至于是在这個副本世界里，或是交流“武道”
，或是搜刮各种武学秘籍，乃至是锻造神兵，各种炼制灵丹妙药带回现实世界之类，极限压榨一个副本世界的资源，以此成就自身什么的……
开玩笑呢！
现在的时间多紧张啊。
王璃同学这时候不抓紧学习，哪有时间把精力放在那一点点小事上？
这要是少听了几句，以后谁能付得起责任啊？

而且还是为了修行“武道”
……
“唉～”
想到某处，王同学都忍不住叹气。
“武道”
这玩意儿啊，怎么说呢。
不能说它不好，也不能说它没前途。
但修炼时间长，消耗资源多，最后威力还不怎么样的问题，从来都让王璃抓破脑袋。
如果只是这样还好，可关键是王璃的武道资质，那是真不怎么样。
在这样一撞十八年，结果被撞头撞的头冒金星，浑身都不好的王同学，算是彻底明白，就以他自己的这一身武道资质，这辈子基本也就彻底告别自行车了。
有那时间，王璃还不如好好琢磨自己的“小宇宙”
毕竟谁又规定，修炼“小宇宙”
的圣斗士就不能是一个武者了？
毕竟武道岂是如此不便之物？
这年头谁还不是个武者啊。
反正王璃就觉得，自己一定就是个“武者”
王璃相信，在这战场上被自己的真诚善良所感动的诸侯武将们，他们一定都相信自己是个“武者”
吧...
谁敢不肯承认，那王同学就只能让那些人，去跟这里的诸侯武将们一样，去和他们好好的探讨一下，究竟什么叫做“武者”
了……
content_en:
Chapter 19 So...burn it, my little universe!
[New book, please vote for recommendations, monthly votes, and favorites]
"Ah*｀へ′*!"
"It turns out you are such a Cao Mengde!"
"You shameless old thief, you are still here barking and barking. I never thought that there is such a shameless person like you in the world!"
When the dozens of princes and generals present listened to Boss Cao talk about his advanced humanistic knowledge, they all secretly despised Boss Cao's shameless personal style deep in their hearts!
But cast aside, cast aside.
But it didn't hinder it at all. Everyone unknowingly raised their ears high.
Everyone was silent, trying to learn Boss Cao's life experience, learn it well and master it, and one must be better than someone who is good at it.
Classmate Wang Li glanced at these people, feeling extremely shameless and too lazy to talk to these guys: "Bah!
What are the thoughts of each of you? Do you really think I can’t tell? I, Wang Li, am kind-hearted and don’t want to tell the truth in front of my face. "
Wang Li continued to secretly despise this group and nodded again.
It has to be said that Boss Cao has not yet evolved to the "ultimate body" that he will be in the future.
, but some truths are of the same origin, and Wang Li was eye-opening when he heard them.
As for whether it is in this dungeon world or exchanging "martial arts"
, or search for various martial arts secrets, or even forge magic weapons, refine various elixirs and bring them back to the real world, etc., squeeze the resources of a copy world to the limit, in order to achieve one's own achievements...
What a joke!
Time is so tight right now.
If Wang Li doesn't study hard at this time, how can he have time to focus on those little things?
If we don’t listen to a few words, who can afford to take responsibility in the future?
And it’s also for the purpose of practicing “martial arts”
…
"Alas~"
Thinking of something, classmate Wang couldn't help but sigh.
"Martial Arts"
What should I say about this thing?
You can’t say it’s not good, nor can you say it has no future.
However, the problem of long training time, high consumption of resources, and lack of power in the end has always made Wang Li scratch his head.
It would be fine if it was just like this, but the key is Wang Li's martial arts qualifications, which are really not that good.
After eighteen years of this kind of collision, Wang was hit so hard that his head exploded with stars, and his whole body felt bad. He finally understood that with his own martial arts qualifications, he would basically say goodbye to cycling for the rest of his life.
With that time, Wang Li might as well think about his own "small universe"
After all, who stipulates that cultivating the "small universe"
Can't the Saint Seiya be a warrior?
After all, is martial arts such an inconvenience?
Who is not a warrior these days?
Anyway, Wang Li felt that he must be a "warrior"
Wang Li believes that the princes and generals who were moved by his sincerity and kindness on this battlefield must all believe that he is a "warrior"
Well...
Whoever dares to refuse to admit it, then Mr. Wang can only let those people, like the princes and generals here, discuss with them what exactly is a "warrior"
Already...
